title: Coverage is verified but partial
detail: 71 listings across 10 sports are published; seven category pages have no verified rows and 64 listings are unpriced. This is not a worldwide full-list claim. Empty categories and missing prices remain visible rather than backfilled.

title: Most fixtures cannot be priced responsibly
detail: Only four non-conditional MLB games and three EuroLeague fixtures have paired official model inputs. Every other winner, handicap and total is blank/withheld with a row-level reason.

title: NHL coverage stops after 25 October
detail: All 19 NHL games on 23-25 October were transcribed, but 26-29 October schedule chunks were not. No zero-game inference is made for those dates.

title: NBA pairings did not render
detail: The official NBA calendar reports 12 games on 23 October and eight on 24 October, but its match-card area returned an error. OLBG-only pairings were not promoted.

title: PDC schedule is behind a privacy interstitial
detail: The official PDC article returned consent text rather than the draw, so no darts fixture or price is claimed as verified.

title: Volleyball competition/season needs reconciliation
detail: The PlusLiga URL redirected to TAURON Liga; its title says 2024/2025 while displayed matches are dated October 2026. Rows are withheld until the correct competition page is isolated.

title: AFLW match cards absent from extraction
detail: Two official page chunks returned navigation and footer content but no fixtures. No historical AFLW rows were re-stamped.

title: eSports pairings absent from extraction
detail: The official LoL Esports schedule shell and Worlds link returned without match pairings in the extracted content.

title: No eligible Gaelic football row observed
detail: The GAA page displayed a Shinty-Hurling International, which is excluded. This is not evidence of a worldwide zero-fixture schedule.

title: Greyhound runner card unavailable
detail: GBGB's page exposed its racing search interface and reports, not a future field. No dog, trap or price was inferred.

title: Bermuda event is already in progress
detail: PGA TOUR marks Round 1 In Progress, so the tournament is excluded from pre-event picks. The correct Bermuda tournament ID is R2026528; R2026028 resolves to the BMW Championship.

title: World Series Game 5 is conditional
detail: MLB labels game 849799 ifNecessary=Y. Its fixture remains visible but all prices and winner preference are blank.

title: High clearance is only 0.04 percentage points
detail: Under 10 with a push has conditional probability 0.700400, just above the strict 70% gate, and fair -234. The model is not calibrated out-of-sample and omits pitchers, lineups, park and postseason effects; High is a rules label, not a guarantee.

title: Games 1-4 have identical MLB model numbers
detail: The same two regular-season team inputs and no venue adjustment produce identical lines for all four non-conditional games. They are separate fixtures, not independent confirmations or four separate betting edges.

title: WST fourth quarter-final is not yet named
detail: Match 60 is officially Winner of match 55 v Winner of match 56. It is excluded from the named match table until the players are official.

title: Leinster venue is TBC
detail: The official URC fixture list says TBC for Leinster v Munster; venue is blank.

title: Ospreys kick-off correction applied
detail: The older full fixture list says 19:45; a later official adjustment says 19:00 UK. The desk uses 19:00 and links the correction.

title: EHF calendar extraction is incomplete
detail: Eleven fixtures were transcribed from the first EHF calendar chunk. Later chunks were not read, and venue/timezone remain blank on every handball row.

title: Unlabelled publication clocks are not converted
detail: WTA, IRL, PCB, WST and EHF rows keep the publisher's display value; UTC remains blank where no timezone is stated. URC keeps its explicitly labelled local-zone clock.

title: F1 is an event card, not a match prediction
detail: The race has practice and qualifying before it. No driver line is originated from the schedule alone and track-local time is not converted.

title: OLBG tip share is not a market price
detail: The baseball hub showed 16/20 (80%) for Milwaukee, while this desk's independent winner estimate is 55.54%. Tip share was not used as a probability or bookmaker quote.
